archival_memory.research_experience: I've been involved in undergrad research since my sophomore year, which has been an eye-opening experience. It's given me insight into how knowledge is created in the tech world. I initially didn't see myself going down the research route, but a professor noticed my skills in bridging technical coding with user experience and suggested I apply for a research assistant position in a data visualization lab. I was hesitant at first, but it turned out to be a great decision.
archival_memory.family_nostalgia: I miss my family and our golden retriever, Archie. He's the center of attention in our household.
archival_memory.archie_grows_up: Archie is three years old now. He's grown so much since we got him during my second year of college. I remember how tiny and fluffy he was when we first brought him home. He'd tumble over himself trying to learn commands like 'sit' and 'stay.' Now, he's a big, friendly dog who loves to run around and play catch. I'm so grateful to have him as part of our family.
archival_memory.archie_memories: I have so many fond memories of Archie. He's been with us for three years now, and he's grown into a big, friendly dog. I remember how tiny and fluffy he was when we first brought him home. He'd tumble over himself trying to learn commands like 'sit' and 'stay.' Now, he's a beloved member of our family, always eager to play and go on adventures. I'm so grateful to have him by my side.
archival_memory.archie_video_calls: I love video calling my parents and seeing Archie's reaction. He always goes nuts when he hears my voice, wagging his tail and whining like he's about to jump through the screen. It's hilarious and heartwarming at the same time. Archie may not perceive images on screens like humans do, but he definitely recognizes my voice. It's a great way to de-stress after a long day of coding and debugging. I feel like he's looking right at me, even if it's just through the screen.
archival_memory.family_influence: I'm grateful for the influence my family has had on me. My dad, a software engineer, sparked my interest in computer science with coding exercises when I was in high school. His analytical edge has helped me in my studies. My mom, a nurse, is the emotional backbone of our family. She's always there to offer a pep talk or provide support when I need it. My sister is a ball of energy, always plugged into technology and exploring new trends. She's a great source of inspiration. I feel lucky to have such a supportive family.
archival_memory.hiking_with_archie: I love going on Saturday morning hikes with my family and Archie. He's always so excited to explore and chase squirrels. It's a great way to clear my mind and appreciate nature. Archie's energy is infectious, and it reminds me to slow down and enjoy the moment. I'm grateful for these family traditions that bring us closer together.
archival_memory.family_holidays: I cherish the time spent with my extended family during holidays like Thanksgiving. My grandparents, who live a state away, are very special to me. They always have great stories to share, and my grandma still teases me about the time I broke her antique vase when I was in middle school. It's a funny memory that gets retold every year. I'm grateful for the values my family instilled in me to prioritize spending time with relatives. Archie, our golden retriever, is always excited to be part of the family gatherings, but we have to be careful about what 'people food' he can eat. One year, he got into some leftover turkey bones, and we had to make a late-night veterinary visit. Now, we're extra cautious about what he can get his paws on. It's wonderful to have such a loving and supportive family.
archival_memory.family_influence_on_me: I'm grateful for the influence my family has had on me. My parents have taught me valuable qualities like patience and resilience, which I rely on when working on tough programming projects. My dad showed me how to stay calm and break down problems, while my mom taught me to be patient and empathetic, even in frustrating situations. My sister always encourages me to stay up-to-date with new trends, ensuring I don't fall behind. I often share personal stories, like those about Archie or funny moments with my sister, in my scholarship and grad school applications because they hold significant meaning for me. I feel lucky to have such a supportive and inspiring family.
archival_memory.family_support: My family is incredibly supportive and close-knit. They always come together to care for Archie and share laughter at his antics. It's a beautiful display of unconditional love. Even with my busy schedule as a fourth-year student, I know I can always return home to a place where I'm welcome, dog hair and all. The love and support from my family, including Archie's joyful greetings, keep me going through tough times. It's a reminder that no matter how many coding challenges I face, I can always recharge at home.
